actions.description: Inspect seed service and existing data
actions.command: systemctl cat failover-seed 2>&1; echo ----; f=$(systemctl show -p ExecStart failover-seed | grep -oE '/nix/store/[^ ;]+' | head -1); echo "$f"; cat "$f" 2>/dev/null; echo ----; sqlite3 /var/lib/failover/records.sqlite3 'select * from records;' 2>/dev/null || python3 -c "import sqlite3;print(sqlite3.connect('/var/lib/failover/records.sqlite3').execute('select * from records').fetchall())"; echo ----; systemctl is-enabled failover-proxy failover-replica failover-seed; stat -c '%U:%G %a %n' /var/lib/failover/*; mount | grep -E ' / | /var';

actions.description: Fence old primary, promote replica, switch proxy atomically
actions.command:
cd /var/lib/failover && python3 - <<'PY'
import os, http.client, sys
D="/var/lib/failover"
def atomic_write(name, data):
    tmp=os.path.join(D, "."+name+".tmp"); path=os.path.join(D, name)
    with open(tmp,"w") as f:
        f.write(data); f.flush(); os.fsync(f.fileno())
    os.chmod(tmp,0o644); os.rename(tmp,path)
    dfd=os.open(D,os.O_DIRECTORY); os.fsync(dfd); os.close(dfd)
def get(port,path):
    c=http.client.HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1",port,timeout=2); c.request("GET",path); r=c.getresponse(); return r.status, r.read()
# 1. preflight: replica healthy, old primary dead
assert get(8082,"/health")==(200,b"ready"), "replica unhealthy"
